items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: I went into the Caverns with Bobby Timmons for three months.

ctx.x: How did the association with Tommy Flanagan and Ella come about?

I stayed with Charlie Byrd until June of ‘64 in Washington, and then I went into the Caverns with Bobby Timmons for three months. And Ray Brown came in and Ray and I have been good friends going back with Herb Ellis and back when I was with Dinah. And whenever they’d come to Washington I used to have them over for dinner, fix dinner for them. So he said, “Ella’s going to need a bass player, would you like to go with her?” And I said, “well okay,” so I went the first time in ‘64. And I stayed a year. And then she…

then there was a T.V. show that I would do five days a week with Mark Russell, the comedian, the politician comedian, “The Mark and Ginger Show” so I decided not to go back with Ella because by this time we had three children and I wanted to buy a house. So we stayed there and bought the house.
